metadata.case_name: ASHLEY MIDDLETON AND ANOTHER v. CHENG KING YING AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_before: Staff Sergeant in the British Army (Pay Corps)
plaintiff.occupation_after: Staff Sergeant in the British Army (Pay Corps)

injuries.description: a left ear hearing loss of moderate severity. This has been measured at 45 dB in the speech frequency which I am told represents a 45% loss of hearing in the left ear.
source: He is left with a left sided tinnitus, or constant noise in the ear, and a left ear hearing loss of moderate severity. This has been measured at 45 dB in the speech frequency which I am told represents a 45% loss of hearing in the left ear.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of middle or inner ear

manifestations.description: left sided tinnitus, or constant noise in the ear
left ear hearing loss measured at 45 dB in the speech frequency (45% loss of hearing in the left ear)
interferes to a minor degree with Mr Middleton's work
he does not always hear at first when people speak to him, especially from the left side
It is slightly awkward to hold the telephone to his right ear with his left hand in order to leave his right hand free for writing
His enjoyment of music is affected
It is a slight social embarrassment
he cannot always readily identify the source of a sound

losses.description: Left ear hearing loss of moderate severity measured at 45 dB (45% loss of hearing in the left ear) and left sided tinnitus
He will remain in category "FE" (Fit Everywhere) but certain avenues of his Army career, particularly those likely to involve active fighting situations, will be closed to him.
It is a slight social embarrassment

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: His enjoyment of music is affected
